name: lv_obj_scroll_to_x

ownership.argument: borrows a live LVGL object; absolute horizontal scroll

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-11-4.100.179 image/IDB: Deletes the running scroll-x animation, reads lv_obj_get_scroll_x and calls the bounded scroll_by with the difference. Located by its field layout in the LVGL v9.0 lv_obj_spec_attr_t and by the firmware's own Lua binding of the same method.

notes: Static recovery only; Mirage is emulator evidence. UI owner thread only. The object must be a live LVGL object created on this page.
